parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the lighter is made of stainless steel and serves as a protective cover for the ignition mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal components from dust and moisture and prevents accidental ignition when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge to open and close, allowing access to the ignition area.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small steel component located near the top of the lighter, used to generate sparks.
parts.Functional_description: When rotated against a flint, it produces sparks that ignite the fuel vapor to create a flame.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis when flicked by the thumb to create friction and sparks.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, typically made of brass for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the fuel reservoir, wick, and supports the ignition assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the structural foundation of the lighter.
